# Episode Analysis: Bride of Charlie – Monument Episode 66
- **Episode title:** AND ANOTHER ONE: Charlie's Text On September 9th. | Candace Ep 299
- **Source used for analysis:** YouTube auto-captions cleaned with video context
- **Transcript completeness:** Auto captions cleaned (lexicon + paragraph merge); music cues dropped
- Existing Nodes Reused: N-1 (Charlie Kirk), N-2 (Erika Kirk)

This episode advances the investigation along three evidentiary tracks. First, the host reads a Daily Mail article defending Erika Kirk against "grief policing" and quotes its two cited experts (Dr. Alan Wolfelt and Bidwell Smith), using the published text as an artifact anchor for the public defense framing around Erica's behavior.

Second, the host introduces a new donor-targeting narrative supported by a first-person email from a Catholic attendee of the memorial and mass. The email, read aloud, supplies artifact-anchored details about Father Blank (the priest who flew with Erica to Utah, prayed at the hospital, and delivered the homily at the private funeral), including a 6:30am text mentioning "Erika may be there too" and a follow-up reply stating "God's fingerprints are all over" the donor's connection to Erica. A separately introduced TPUSA text references a $6 million memorial cost tied to a displaced "lucrative RV show" at Cardinal Stadium; the host claims she checked the Wayback Machine and found no such RV show on the calendar.

Third, the host introduces a September 9 group-chat text attributed to Charlie Kirk quoting 1 Corinthians 16:9 ("…there are many adversaries"), and plays two on-air clips – a Frank Turek sermon excerpt calling the host's claims satanic, and Don Lemon video at a Minnesota church protest. Structural importance: this episode pivots from prior Zoom/audio coverage into donor-intelligence narrative and adds an artifact class (donor email + threaded texts) that maps alleged TPUSA fundraising conduct.

The host says the woman who tapped the donor's shoulder at the post-mass church and invited her to sit with Erika was Stacy Sheridan.
Verify the email's metadata, the donor's identity, the priest's actual name and parish, and confirm the September mass timeline independently.

Obtain phone records or screenshots of the actual text thread; verify whether "may be there" phrasing reflects typical priest communication or pre-coordinated signal.

Obtain forensic verification of text message origin, timestamp, and sender device; identify the third group-chat participant's account.

lines: - **Name uncertainty:** "Andrew Kolvet" / "Kouvet" / "Covette" / "Coven" – transcript shows multiple spellings for the same TPUSA figure (N-14). Requires human verification against correct spelling.
- **Artifact verbally referenced but not shown:** A-1712.1 (Wayback Machine screenshots for Cardinal Stadium RV show) – referenced verbally but not displayed on-screen. Marked Low confidence.

- **Artifact verbally referenced but not shown:** Vanessa Bryant's Kobe memorial speech is recommended for viewing by the host but never played, quoted, or displayed in the episode. Comparison claim C-5911 should be re-anchored if/when the speech artifact is produced.

- **Name redaction in source:** "Father Blank" and "TPUSA Blank" are host-applied redactions of the email author's original names; the actual names were blanked out before air and are not recoverable from this artifact alone.

- **Host claim without artifact anchor:** N-10437 (Father Blank's alleged cancellation of his regular September 10 mass) is asserted by the host without supporting artifact. Recommend verifying via parish bulletin, diocese calendar, or live-streamed mass archive.
- **Transcript ambiguity:** Host refers to "Andrew Coven" (in comment section) and "Andrew Kouvet" (in interview discussion); same person referenced by all variants.

- **Claim passed admission test with host-interpretation caveat:** C-5911 (Vanessa Bryant comparison) uses Kobe Bryant memorial speech as comparison anchor; speech itself is not artifact-presented in this episode. Investigative direction flags this for follow-up.
